reconstructed_values.hidden_geometry: Boom, stick, bucket and slew centers other than the published 2.9 m stick span; all hydraulic anchors; linkage topology; track pitch and phase; and internal structure are independently reconstructed.
reconstructed_values.physical_joint_study: All four visible hydraulic assemblies have measured barrel-to-rod overlap, endpoint eyes and structural pins. The dogbone terminates at visible bellcrank and bucket-root lug ears and pins.
reconstructed_values.pose_scope: Stowed transport and articulated review poses are independently measured. Continuous manufacturer motion limits, cylinder travel, swept collision, load, safety and operating behavior remain unclaimed.
reconstructed_values.bucket_tip_witness: An exported mesh apex under Bucket_ROOT coincides with the farthest bucket-tooth planar point at the published 1.570 m radius.
reconstructed_values.track_loop: Each 49-shoe reconstructed loop is normalized to a measured 4.450 m subtree length while preserving the 3.650 m sprocket/idler center separation and 2.380 m gauge.

mechanical_gaps: No manufacturer-authoritative boom, bucket, slew, hydraulic-anchor or linkage pivot coordinates
No continuous manufacturer motion-limit, cylinder-stroke, collision, load, stability or safety solver
No authoritative track pitch, sprocket phase or individual roller center geometry
